facts.fact: Mali's Council of Ministers on 9 October 2026 took note of a written communication saying the 4th Schema Directeur de la Statistique and its 2026-2030 action plan have been drawn up as the reference framework, after earlier schemas adopted in 2006, 2014 and 2020; it records no adoption.
